::: {.book-summary} ## Book Summary Insight Exodus recounts God's deliverance of Israel from slavery, the establishment of His covenant, and His presence among His people. The book teaches that God is a powerful Redeemer who rescues His people, calls them into covenant relationship, and desires faithful worship and obedience. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 1
Exodus 1:8
A new king arose
### Why This Verse Sets Israel's oppression in motion ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes Israel's oppression in Egypt as their numbers increase. The key verse highlights God's blessing despite Pharaoh's attempts to suppress His people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 2
Exodus 2:24
God remembered His covenant
### Why This Verse Turning point toward deliverance ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the birth, preservation, and early life of Moses. The key verse demonstrates God's providential preparation of Israel's future deliverer. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 3
Exodus 3:14
“I AM THAT I AM”
### Why This Verse One of the most important divine self-revelations ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts God's appearance to Moses in the burning bush. The key verse reveals God's covenant name and eternal self-existence. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 4
Exodus 4:12
I will be with thy mouth
### Why This Verse God's assurance to Moses ### Chapter Insight This chapter details God's commissioning of Moses despite his objections. The key verse assures Moses that God equips those He calls. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 5
Exodus 5:2
“Who is the LORD?”
### Why This Verse Pharaoh's defining challenge ### Chapter Insight This chapter begins Moses' confrontation with Pharaoh. The key verse captures Pharaoh's rejection of God's authority. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 6
Exodus 6:7
I will take you to be My people
### Why This Verse Covenant redemption promise ### Chapter Insight This chapter reaffirms God's covenant promises to Israel. The key verse emphasizes God's commitment to redeem His people from bondage. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 7
Exodus 7:5
Egyptians shall know I am the LORD
### Why This Verse Purpose of the plagues ### Chapter Insight This chapter introduces the plagues through Moses and Aaron's confrontation with Pharaoh. The key verse reveals God's purpose of making Himself known. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 8
Exodus 8:23
I will put a division between My people and thy people
### Why This Verse Divine distinction emphasized ### Chapter Insight This chapter continues the plagues and demonstrates God's power over Egypt's gods. The key verse highlights Pharaoh's temporary repentance without true submission. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 9
Exodus 9:16
Raised up to show My power
### Why This Verse Frequently cited by Paul (Romans 9) ### Chapter Insight This chapter records additional plagues and Pharaoh's continued hardness of heart. The key verse explains God's purpose in displaying His power throughout the earth. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 10
Exodus 10:2
Tell your son and grandson
### Why This Verse Importance of remembering God's acts ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes the plagues of locusts and darkness. The key verse emphasizes God's sovereignty in accomplishing His purposes. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 11
Exodus 11:7
The LORD puts a difference
### Why This Verse Final plague preview ### Chapter Insight This chapter announces the final plague against Egypt. The key verse prepares for God's decisive act of deliverance. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 12
Exodus 12:13
When I see the blood
### Why This Verse Central Passover verse ### Chapter Insight This chapter institutes the Passover and records Israel's deliverance. The key verse establishes the Passover as a lasting memorial of redemption. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 13
Exodus 13:9
Memorial upon thy hand
### Why This Verse Foundation for remembrance traditions ### Chapter Insight This chapter focuses on consecration and God's guidance after the Exodus. The key verse emphasizes remembering God's mighty deliverance. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 14
Exodus 14:14
The LORD shall fight for you
### Why This Verse One of Exodus' best-known promises ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Israel's crossing of the Red Sea. The key verse calls God's people to trust Him while He fights on their behalf. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 15
Exodus 15:2
The LORD is my strength and song
### Why This Verse Classic song of deliverance ### Chapter Insight This chapter celebrates God's victory through the Song of Moses. The key verse declares God's unmatched greatness and power. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 16
Exodus 16:4
Bread from heaven
### Why This Verse Manna narrative centerpiece ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts God's provision of manna in the wilderness. The key verse teaches dependence upon God's daily provision. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 17
Exodus 17:15
Jehovah-nissi
### Why This Verse Famous divine title ### Chapter Insight This chapter records water from the rock and victory over Amalek. The key verse highlights God's presence and faithfulness among His people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 18
Exodus 18:21
Able men over thousands
### Why This Verse Classic leadership/delegation model ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes Jethro's counsel regarding leadership. The key verse emphasizes wise delegation and shared responsibility. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 19
Exodus 19:5
A treasured possession
### Why This Verse Israel's covenant identity ### Chapter Insight This chapter prepares Israel to meet God at Mount Sinai. The key verse reveals God's desire for Israel to be His holy nation. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 20
Exodus 20:3
Thou shalt have no other gods
### Why This Verse Beginning of the Ten Commandments ### Chapter Insight This chapter gives the Ten Commandments. The key verse summarizes God's covenant authority as the basis for His commandments. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 21
Exodus 21:24
Eye for eye
### Why This Verse Most quoted law in the chapter ### Chapter Insight This chapter provides laws governing justice and relationships. The key verse reflects God's concern for fairness and accountability. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 22
Exodus 22:21
Do not oppress a stranger
### Why This Verse Foundational social justice text ### Chapter Insight This chapter continues covenant laws concerning property and social responsibility. The key verse emphasizes compassion and justice toward others. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 23
Exodus 23:20
I send an Angel before thee
### Why This Verse Guidance and protection promise ### Chapter Insight This chapter outlines additional laws and covenant blessings. The key verse promises God's guidance and protection through obedience. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 24
Exodus 24:7
All that the LORD hath spoken we will do
### Why This Verse Covenant ratification ### Chapter Insight This chapter formally confirms the covenant between God and Israel. The key verse expresses Israel's commitment to obey God's commands. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 25
Exodus 25:8
Let them make Me a sanctuary
### Why This Verse Purpose of the tabernacle ### Chapter Insight This chapter begins instructions for building the Tabernacle. The key verse reveals God's desire to dwell among His people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 26
Exodus 26:33
The veil shall separate
### Why This Verse Key tabernacle symbolism ### Chapter Insight This chapter details the structure of the Tabernacle. The key verse emphasizes the holiness and order of God's dwelling place. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 27
Exodus 27:20
Pure oil for the lamp
### Why This Verse Worship continuity ### Chapter Insight This chapter gives instructions for the altar and courtyard. The key verse focuses on worship and access to God's presence. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 28
Exodus 28:36
HOLINESS TO THE LORD
### Why This Verse Priesthood's defining inscription ### Chapter Insight This chapter establishes the priesthood and sacred garments. The key verse highlights the priest's role in representing God's people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 29
Exodus 29:45
I will dwell among Israel
### Why This Verse Goal of priestly ministry ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes the consecration of the priests. The key verse emphasizes God's intention to dwell among Israel through worship. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 30
Exodus 30:10
Atonement once a year
### Why This Verse Day of Atonement connection ### Chapter Insight This chapter provides instructions for worship furnishings and offerings. The key verse stresses holiness in approaching God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 31
Exodus 31:13
My Sabbaths you shall keep
### Why This Verse Sabbath as covenant sign ### Chapter Insight This chapter appoints craftsmen and reinforces the Sabbath. The key verse shows that God equips individuals for His work. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 32
Exodus 32:32
Blot me out of Your book
### Why This Verse Moses' intercession ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Israel's sin with the golden calf. The key verse reveals the seriousness of idolatry and covenant unfaithfulness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 33
Exodus 33:14
My presence shall go with thee
### Why This Verse Famous promise of God's presence ### Chapter Insight This chapter highlights Moses' intercession and desire for God's presence. The key verse expresses the necessity of God's presence among His people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 34
Exodus 34:6
Merciful and gracious, longsuffering
### Why This Verse Most repeated divine description in Scripture ### Chapter Insight This chapter renews the covenant after Israel's sin. The key verse reveals God's character as merciful, gracious, and forgiving. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 35
Exodus 35:21
Everyone whose heart stirred him
### Why This Verse Voluntary worship giving ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Israel's response in contributing to the Tabernacle. The key verse highlights willing hearts devoted to God's work. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 36
Exodus 36:6
The people bring much more than enough
### Why This Verse Notable generosity passage ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes the construction of the Tabernacle. The key verse demonstrates the people's generosity and obedience. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 37
Exodus 37:1
Bezalel made the ark
### Why This Verse Ark construction highlight ### Chapter Insight This chapter details the making of the Tabernacle furnishings. The key verse reflects careful obedience to God's instructions. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 38
Exodus 38:8
Laver made from mirrors
### Why This Verse Most memorable detail ### Chapter Insight This chapter records completion of the courtyard and sacred objects. The key verse emphasizes accountability and stewardship in God's work. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 39
Exodus 39:43
Moses blessed them
### Why This Verse Completion of the work ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes the completion of the priestly garments and Tabernacle items. The key verse highlights Israel's obedience to God's commands. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 40
Exodus 40:34
Glory filled the tabernacle
### Why This Verse Climactic conclusion of Exodus ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the erection of the Tabernacle and God's glory filling it. The key verse marks the fulfillment of God's promise to dwell among His people. :::
